integrity: The proof was reconstructed symbolically from the displayed Bourgain–Morrey norm and the cited Calderón–Lozanovskiĭ definition; the two Hölder steps and all reciprocal-exponent identities were checked directly. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Only a one-sided Calderón–Lozanovskiĭ-to-Bourgain–Morrey embedding is proved; no reverse inclusion or optimality within the Bourgain–Morrey scale is asserted, and the result is restricted to finite nontrivial triples \(1<p_i<u_i<r_i<\infty\).
title: A concrete Bourgain–Morrey envelope for off-diagonal fractional Gagliardo–Nirenberg targets
